description: Overcome fear of ferns in one peaceful Zoom session. No trance, no exposure, no long-term therapy.
heroTag: Stop letting a fear of ferns narrow your world
heroH1: See the fern. Calm and at ease. Finally.
heroP: One peaceful Zoom session. No trance. No reliving trauma. No long-term therapy — a calmer, freer you on your terms.
problemH2: Don’t let a fear of ferns narrow your world
problemP: Gardens and rooms avoided — a specific plant triggers real unease. The villain is not you. It is a misfiring subconscious program — once meant to protect you, now firing indiscriminately.
quote: You are someone who stays at ease around greenery. That person already exists inside you.
externalH3: The fronds, the texture, the room
externalP: Unease at the sight or texture of a fern.
internalP: Embarrassed by a reaction to a plant. Feeling alone in it.
deeperH3: A world fenced by one fear
deeperP: Rooms avoided. Gardens skipped. Spaces you stopped letting yourself enjoy.
reliefP: By the end of your session you will feel your world shift. Stay present. Feel ease. Move freely.
cost1P: The room or garden you keep skipping.
cost2P: Each avoided space becomes a larger pattern.
cost3P: If avoiding ferns hasn’t fixed the fear, it won’t next season either.
ctaH2: Your next calm space is one session away
